newsitem.title: USA: Austrian tackled in Key West over pedicab fare.
newsitem.headline: Austrian tackled in Key West over pedicab fare.

text.p: An Austrian tourist was arrested by Key West police after refusing to pay a $12 fare for a ride in a "pedicab," a bicycle pedal-powered cab, police said on Monday.
Roland Zimmer, 40, climbed into one of the island's pedicabs on Friday night but ended the ride early after he complained the driver had taken him in the wrong direction.
An argument followed outside a grocery store. Key West police officer Eric Biskup arrived at the scene and ordered Zimmer to pay the $12 fare, which was accumulated at a rate of $1 per minute.
Zimmer was "taken to the ground" and handcuffed when he refused, according to the police report. He was charged with petty theft and taken to the local jail, police said.
He posted $280 bond and was released soon after being booked. It was unknown which town Zimmer came from in Austria.
